# AllTrails
> AllTrails helps people discover, navigate, and review hiking, biking, running, and camping trails worldwide.

AllTrails combines a large trail database with maps, route details, photos, reviews, and mobile tools for planning outdoor adventures. The site also includes curated destination pages, national park trail collections, support resources, and information about AllTrails membership features.

## Trail Discovery
- [AllTrails Home](https://www.alltrails.com/): Main entry point for discovering trails, maps, reviews, and outdoor route recommendations.
- [Explore Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/explore): Browse trails by activity, location, difficulty, and popularity.
- [Hiking Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/hiking): Explore hiking trails and walking routes across destinations in the United States.
- [Mountain Biking Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/mountain-biking): Find mountain biking trails with route details, maps, and community reviews.
- [Trail Running Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/trail-running): Discover trail running routes with elevation, distance, and difficulty information.
- [Backpacking Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/backpacking): Browse backpacking routes for multi-day and longer-distance outdoor trips.
- [Camping Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/camping): Find trails and routes commonly used for camping and overnight adventures.

## National Parks
- [National Parks](https://www.alltrails.com/parks): Browse trail guides and route collections for parks and protected areas.
- [Yosemite National Park](https://www.alltrails.com/parks/us/california/yosemite-national-park): Explore trails, maps, and reviews for Yosemite National Park.
- [Yellowstone National Park](https://www.alltrails.com/parks/us/wyoming/yellowstone-national-park): Find hiking routes and popular trail guides in Yellowstone.
- [Zion National Park](https://www.alltrails.com/parks/us/utah/zion-national-park): Discover Zion trails with route details, photos, and user reviews.
- [Grand Canyon National Park](https://www.alltrails.com/parks/us/arizona/grand-canyon-national-park): Browse Grand Canyon trail options and route information.
- [Rocky Mountain National Park](https://www.alltrails.com/parks/us/colorado/rocky-mountain-national-park): View popular hikes and mapped routes in Rocky Mountain National Park.

## Destinations
- [United States Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us): Explore trails, parks, and outdoor destinations across the United States.
- [California Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/california): Browse hiking and outdoor routes throughout California.
- [Colorado Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/colorado): Discover trails, mountain routes, and park hikes in Colorado.
- [Washington Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/washington): Find trails for hiking, running, and backpacking in Washington.
- [Canada Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/canada): Explore trail guides and route collections across Canada.
- [United Kingdom Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/united-kingdom): Browse outdoor routes and trail guides in the United Kingdom.

## Activities
- [Walking Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/walking): Find walking-friendly trails with maps and community ratings.
- [Birding Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/birding): Explore trails popular for birdwatching and wildlife observation.
- [Fishing Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/fishing): Browse routes and outdoor areas commonly used for fishing access.
- [Off-Road Driving Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/off-road-driving): Discover off-road driving routes and mapped trail information.
- [Road Biking Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/road-biking): Find road biking routes and cycling-friendly trail guides.
- [Snowshoeing Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/snowshoeing): Explore snowshoeing routes for winter outdoor recreation.

## Trip Planning
- [Best Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/explore/us): Browse popular and highly rated trails in the United States.
- [Easy Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/easy): Find beginner-friendly and lower-difficulty trail options.
- [Moderate Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/moderate): Explore moderate trails with balanced distance and elevation profiles.
- [Hard Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/hard): Browse challenging trails for experienced hikers and runners.
- [Kid Friendly Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/kids): Find family-friendly trails suitable for children.
- [Dog Friendly Trails](https://www.alltrails.com/us/dogs): Discover trails that allow dogs and outdoor trips with pets.

- [AllTrails Home](https://www.alltrails.com/): Review core product features for trail discovery and route planning.

- [Community on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/alltrails/): Follow AllTrails social content and outdoor community highlights.
